_comment: Copy to cloudwatch-triage/config.json and edit. Drives scripts/collect-cloudwatch-errors.py and the /log-triage command. The live config.json is gitignored (it names internal log groups).

aws._comment: AWS CLI profile + region used for the CloudWatch Logs Insights queries. The profile needs logs:StartQuery, logs:GetQueryResults, logs:StopQuery on the target log groups (read-only).

query._comment_1: CloudWatch Logs Insights filter. `pattern` is matched against @message (case-insensitive substring OR-list). Lines matching ANY term are pulled.
query._comment_2: lookback_hours: default window scanned each run (override with --hours). limit: max raw matching lines per log group.

services._comment: One entry per service to watch. `log_groups` are the EXACT CloudWatch log-group names (discover with: aws logs describe-log-groups --query 'logGroups[].logGroupName'). base_branch/assignee override the defaults below.
services.name: orders-service

defaults._comment_1: Applied to any service that doesn't override the field. default_base_branch is where fix branches are cut from and PRs target.
defaults._comment_2: assignee.github: GitHub handle to assign/request-review on the PR. assignee.email: dev notified about the PR (defaults to the Claude account email).

triage._comment_1: max_issues_per_run: how many top-ranked clusters to actually fix per run. Keep at 1 until trusted.
triage._comment_2: draft_prs: always open PRs as drafts (the dev review is the merge gate). auto_fix false = report-only, never touches code.
triage._comment_3: confidence_floor: only clusters the investigation rates >= this get a code PR; anything lower downgrades to a report entry.

notifier._comment_1: How the assigned dev is told about a PR. github_review_request always fires (assignment emails the reviewer).
notifier._comment_2: email.transport: 'gmail-mcp' works for interactive runs; headless cron should use 'ses' (aws ses send-email, reuses the aws profile above) or 'none' to rely on the GitHub reviewer email.
